'''New Allies''' is a modern Star Wars CCG playtest team. Holotheatre called it "one of the largest and probably the best known team in Star Wars ccg."<ref name="ht-s5e7">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BTf2c32VjUs Holotheatre S5 Ep 7: The New Allies Take Indy], Star Wars CCG (19 April 2024)</ref> Players Committee wraps use the name on individual major wins. The team has a Slack channel; Holotheatre guests have talked about camaraderie there and at live events.

Holotheatre S5 E7 also named Jeremy, [[Chris Gogolen]], MHT ([[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]), and Drew as people around the Indianapolis weekend. Barry Alperstein is not New Allies (Holotheatre S5 E1).

== Results ==

At the 2021 U.S. Nationals in Denver, Kafer and Lutz won the Friday team tournament as part of New Allies.<ref name="pc-2021nats">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/swccg-returns-to-live-major-events-olson-wins-us-nationals/ SWCCG Returns to Live Major Events; Olson wins US Nationals], Players Committee (19 July 2021)</ref>

At the 2022 U.S. Nationals the Swiss 1–4 were all New Allies (Fred 8–0, Arlandson 7–1, Shaw, Kessling) before [[Joe Olson]] of [[Team 5]] won the match-play title.<ref name="pc-2022nats">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-us-nationals-wrap-olson-repeats/ 2022 US Nationals wrap], Players Committee</ref>

Hayes Hunter said after the 2023 U.S. Nationals that New Allies also had three in the Top 8, with a first-round team-kill against Team 5.<ref name="ht-s4e14">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bBRVy8vgDFg Holotheatre S4 E14: Nationals Recap with Hayes]</ref>

Tashima won the 2024 Indianapolis Eclipse major. Scott won the 2025 U.S. Nationals. Shaw won the [[2025 World Championship]].
